zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。
en: We need to {check in} two hours before the flight.

zh: 我们得在十点前退房。
en: We have to {check out of|leave} the hotel by ten.

zh: 飞机晚了四十分钟才起飞。
en: The plane {took off|left|departed} forty minutes late.

zh: 周日你能去机场接我父母吗？
en: Can you {pick up|collect|get|fetch|meet} my parents from the airport on Sunday?

zh: 出租车司机把我们的行李送到了错的酒店。
en: The taxi driver {dropped off|dropped|left} our bags at the wrong hotel.

zh: 今天早上我们六点就出发了，好避开堵车。
en: This morning we {set off|left|headed off|set out|took off|headed out} at six to beat the traffic.

zh: 我们上错了公交车，结果到了新市场。
en: We {got on|caught|took|hopped on|jumped on|boarded} the wrong bus and ended up in Newmarket.

zh: 你得在下一站下车。
en: You need to {get off|hop off|get out|jump off} at the next stop.

zh: 我特别期待我们的皇后镇之旅。
en: I'm really {looking forward to|excited about} our trip to Queenstown.

zh: 我们希望复活节能出去玩几天。
en: We're hoping to {get away|go away|escape|travel} for a few days over Easter.

zh: 去伦敦的路上，我们在新加坡中途停留了一晚。
en: We {stopped over|stayed|stopped|stopped off} in Singapore for a night on the way to London.

zh: 我们在海关被耽搁了一个小时。
en: We were {held up|delayed|stuck|stopped|kept} at customs for an hour.

zh: 我们周日晚上回奥克兰。
en: We're {heading back|going back|coming back|flying back|driving back|returning|heading} to Auckland on Sunday night.

zh: 在惠灵顿没有车出行也很方便。
en: It's easy to {get around|get round|travel around|go around} Wellington without a car.

zh: 司机靠边停了车，让救护车过去。
en: The driver {pulled over|pulled in|stopped|moved over} to let the ambulance pass.

zh: 出城之前我们先把油加满吧，越往南油越贵。
en: Let's {fill up|refuel|top up|gas up} before we leave town. Petrol costs more further south.

zh: 我们租的车在去陶波的半路上抛锚了。
en: Our rental car {broke down|died|stopped} halfway to Taupo.

zh: 我们午夜刚过就降落在了基督城。
en: We {touched down|landed|arrived} in Christchurch just after midnight.

zh: 因为订满了，我们没赶上萤火虫洞之旅。
en: We {missed out on|missed} the glow-worm tour because it was fully booked.

zh: 上飞机前我们挤出时间去了一趟霍比屯。
en: We {squeezed in|fitted in|fit in|managed} a quick trip to Hobbiton before our flight.

zh: 他们飞去巴厘岛玩了一周。
en: They {jetted off|flew off|flew} to Bali for a week.

zh: 听说航班取消了，他当场就发飙了。
en: He {kicked off|lost it|flipped out|blew up|went off} when they said the flight was cancelled.

zh: 我们只是路过，不会久留。
en: We're just {passing through}, so we won't stay long.

zh: 导游给我们指出了那座老教堂。
en: The guide {pointed out|showed us} the old church.

zh: 我很想有一天再回皇后镇。
en: I'd love to {go back|return} to Queenstown one day.

zh: 希望我们起飞前雾能散掉。
en: Hopefully the fog will {clear up|lift|clear} before our flight.

zh: 我们挤过人群去找登机口。
en: We {pushed through|squeezed through|made our way through} the crowd to find our gate.

zh: 晚饭前我先去梳洗一下。
en: I'll just {freshen up|wash up|clean up} before dinner.

zh: 我们有一个小时可以在镇上逛逛。
en: We've got an hour to {look around|explore|wander around|walk around} the town.

zh: 这家咖啡馆藏在一条小巷子里。
en: The café is {tucked away|hidden} down a little lane.

zh: 坐船坐得我想吐。
en: The boat ride made me want to {throw up|be sick|vomit}.

zh: 机场的那只小猎犬专门嗅查旅客包里的水果。
en: The beagle at the airport {sniffs out|detects|finds} fruit in people's bags.

zh: 你什么时候从日本回来的？
en: When did you {come back|get back} from Japan?

zh: 退房时请把钥匙交到前台。
en: Please {hand over|hand in|return|leave} your keys at reception when you check out.

zh: 航空公司在学校假期总是抬高票价。
en: Airlines always {jack up|hike up|bump up|put up|push up|raise} prices during the school holidays.

zh: 我们尽可能多地塞进了观光行程。
en: We {crammed in|squeezed in|fitted in|fit in|packed in} as much sightseeing as we could.

zh: 我们正在收拾东西准备退房。
en: We're {packing up} our things to check out.

zh: 你几点到的机场？
en: What time did you {get to|reach|arrive at} the airport?

zh: 我们几点必须退房？
en: What time do we have to {check out|leave}?

zh: 我们在酒店门口拦了一辆出租车。
en: We {flagged down|hailed|stopped} a taxi outside the hotel.

zh: 我们的航班推迟了两个小时。
en: Our flight's been {put back|pushed back|delayed} two hours.

zh: 你昨晚几点回来的？
en: What time did you {get back|come back|get home|come home} last night?

zh: 请大家原地待命，等候进一步通知。
en: Please {stand by|wait} for further instructions.

zh: 一辆出租车在酒店门口停了下来。
en: A taxi {pulled up|drew up|stopped} outside the hotel.

zh: 这条小路通往海滩。
en: This track {leads to|goes to|takes you to|runs to} the beach.

zh: 你的航班几点到？
en: What time does your flight {get in|arrive|land}?

zh: 最好提前做打算，早点订机票。
en: It's good to {think ahead|plan ahead} and book flights early.

zh: 去欧洲的路上，我们会在迪拜停留两天。
en: We're {stopping over|stopping|staying} in Dubai for two days on the way to Europe.

zh: 离开房间前把贵重物品锁起来。
en: {Lock away|Lock up} your valuables before you leave the room.

zh: 我们去机场给我妹妹送行。
en: We went to the airport to {see off|farewell|wave off|say goodbye to} my sister.
